Q8060.reason: John Austin defined jurisprudence as the philosophy of positive law in The Province of Jurisprudence Determined.

Q8095.reason: Attachment theory's earliest phase is indiscriminate social responsiveness, before selective attachment and stranger wariness develop around six to seven months, so the two-month-old is most likely to respond to an unknown adult.

Q5546.reason: The spark was a careless act, and an unintentional smoke invasion is actionable mainly through a breach of reasonable care, so negligence is the most likely basis, though trespass is also arguable.
